newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares edge up in lacklustre trade.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares edge up in lacklustre trade.

text.p: Delhi share prices opened a shade higher in thin early trade on Friday as speculators and foreign investors made selective purchases on the last day of the current settlement period, brokers said.
The Delhi Stock Exchange's sensitive index was 1.05 points higher at 913.52 points after 30 minutes of trade.
Traders said shares of steelmaker TISCO were in the spotlight as institutional investors made purchases.
"Hectic activity in TISCO shares was the only feature of the trade so far," said Ashok Kaul of brokers Rajpaul Chadha. TISCO gained 3.25 rupees to 221.50 on foreign buying.
Reliance Industries inched up 0.25 rupee to 366.00.
State Bank of India rose 0.60 rupee to 348.00.
Hero Honda climbed 5.00 rupees to 575.00 as the share entered a no delivery period for the next one month.
